title: Service Delivery Model
text:
Please describe your  overarching management structure and service delivery model for HMP/YOI Winchester , setting out your key  organisational principles that support an integrated, trauma-informed health and wellbeing service and how you will deliver all elements of the  service specification(s) to achieve the required outcomes.    Please refer to the Service Specification(s), Desktop Health and Social Care Needs Assessment, and Information Pack included in the ITT  documentation.    Your response must include, but need not be limited to:   
• Describe which elements of the service specification(s) you will deliver directly. 
• Explain where and how you will subcontract and collaborate with specialist partners to deliver each aspect of the service specifications,  as a single, integrated service model, including how partners will be selected, managed, and how quality and performance will be   monitored. 
• Describe how your service model will adapt and develop to meet the changing profile of the prison population and future growth, not  limited to, including any transition measures: 
o Changes in National Policy 
o Drug Strategy Policy 
o National Prison Expansion Programme. 
• Describe your approach to implementing an early days in custody strategy.    Please provide as an attachment an overarching service delivery model diagram  and your organisational management structure .  N.B. This attachment must be pictorial in nature and may include minimal narrative as appropriate to ensure it remains in line with  A.12.19 of the ITT Bidder Instructions.

title: Service Provision / Demand Management
text:
Please describe your strategy for demand management and explain your approach to providing services over the duration of the contract in  order to meet the requirements of the service specification(s).     Your response may include, but need not be limited to:   
• Your approach to planning, capacity management, staffing availability (including subcontractors) and contingency arrangements to  manage fluctuating demand, including surge management, increased churn, and how service user data and intelligence will be used  to inform your approach.   
• Your proposed programme of clinics/sessions, including GP provision, and how this meets the service standards, for each service  listed in the service specification(s). 
• How the services will be made available within HMP/YOI Winchester’s core day. Include the operating hours, evenings, weekends  and out of hours provision, and 24-hour cover as applicable. 
• How you will maximise healthcare clinic utilisation, manage referrals, and reduce Did Not Attends (DNAs). 
• Your strategies to reduce the demand for community-based and acute health provision, as well as relevant processes to access  appropriate community-based services.  
• How workforce and health resources, including technology (e.g. telemedicine), will be strategically utilised to ensure appropriate  service availability.    Please provide as an attachment a list of draft clinic/session plans for HMP/YOI Winchester. N.B. This attachment may include  minimal narrative as appropriate to ensure it remains in line with A.12.19 of the ITT Bidder Instructions.

title: Reception and Healthcare Screenings
text:
With reference to the Service Specification(s), Desktop Health and Social Care Needs Assessment and Information Pack provided as part of  the ITT documentation, please describe how reception services will be delivered to meet the specific requirements and challenges of service  provision at HMP/YOI Winchester.    Your response must include, but need not be limited to:   
• Your reception staffing profile, including roles, WTEs, deployment patterns, and evening, night and weekend cover. 
• Your approach to initial assessment, including access, language needs, mental and physical health, substance misuse, medication,  duration of assessment, risk management, and onward care planning. 
• How appropriate screening and pathways will be put in place for those service users who have specific needs, including long-term  conditions, ADHD and autism. 
• How you will manage late receptions and short-notice surges in arrivals at HMP/YOI Winchester.    Please provide as an attachment a draft reception pathway for arrivals at HMP/YOI Winchester. N.B. This attachment must be  pictorial in nature and may include minimal narrative as appropriate to ensure it remains in line with A.12.19 of the ITT Bidder  Instructions.
